title: Passive Voice in Reporting
completion_message: ¡Excelente! La voz pasiva impersonal es el pilar de la redacción formal, el periodismo y los informes corporativos. Usar 'It is believed that' o 'The CEO is said to have resigned' te permite reportar información sin comprometerte o sin señalar culpables directos.

stages.title: Voz Pasiva Impersonal y de Reporte (C1)

parts.visual:
En contextos formales o periodísticos, cuando no sabemos quién dijo algo, o queremos distanciarnos de un rumor, usamos la Pasiva de Reporte. Hay dos estructuras principales. 
Verbos comunes: say, believe, report, expect, consider, think, know. 

Estructura 1 (Con 'It'): It + be + past participle + that... 
Activa: People believe that the company is bankrupt. 
Pasiva 1: IT IS BELIEVED that the company is bankrupt. 
Activa: They reported that the CEO had resigned. 
Pasiva 1: IT WAS REPORTED that the CEO had resigned.
parts.audio: In formal or journalistic contexts, when we don't know who said something, or we want to distance ourselves from a rumor, we use the Reporting Passive. Common verbs include: say, believe, report, expect, consider, think, and know. Structure 1 uses 'It' as an empty subject. Formula: It plus 'be' plus past participle plus 'that'. Active sentence: People believe that the company is bankrupt. Passive 1: IT IS BELIEVED that the company is bankrupt. Active: They reported that the CEO had resigned. Passive 1: IT WAS REPORTED that the CEO had resigned.

parts.visual:
Estructura 2 (Con el Sujeto de la segunda oración): 
Sujeto + be + past participle + TO + infinitivo. 

Si la acción ocurre en el PRESENTE o FUTURO (to + base verb): 
Activa: People expect that the inflation will rise. 
Pasiva 2: The inflation IS EXPECTED TO RISE. 
Activa: They say he is a tough negotiator. 
Pasiva 2: He IS SAID TO BE a tough negotiator. 

Si la acción ocurrió en el PASADO (to have + past participle): 
Activa: They believe the hackers stole the data. 
Pasiva 2: The hackers ARE BELIEVED TO HAVE STOLEN the data. 
Activa: They report that the CEO resigned. 
Pasiva 2: The CEO IS REPORTED TO HAVE RESIGNED.
parts.audio: Structure 2 uses the Subject of the second clause. Formula: Subject plus 'be' plus past participle plus 'TO' plus infinitive. If the action is in the present or future, use 'to' plus the base verb. Active: People expect that the inflation will rise. Passive 2: The inflation IS EXPECTED TO RISE. Active: They say he is a tough negotiator. Passive 2: He IS SAID TO BE a tough negotiator. Now, if the action happened in the PAST, use 'to have' plus past participle. Active: They believe the hackers stole the data. Passive 2: The hackers ARE BELIEVED TO HAVE STOLEN the data. Active: They report that the CEO resigned. Passive 2: The CEO IS REPORTED TO HAVE RESIGNED.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de voz pasiva de reporte.

questions.question: People say that he is very strict. -> It ____ that he is very strict.
People say that he is very strict. -> He is said ____ very strict.
questions.explanation: Sujeto + is said + TO + infinitivo presente (to be).

questions.question: They expect that profits will drop. -> Profits are expected ____.
questions.explanation: Acción futura -> TO + infinitivo simple (to drop).

questions.question: Journalists reported that the bank lost millions. -> It ____ that the bank lost millions.
questions.explanation: El reporte ocurrió en pasado: It WAS reported.

questions.question: People believe that the CFO stole the money. -> The CFO is believed ____ the money.
questions.explanation: Acción pasada (el robo) -> TO HAVE + past participle (to have stolen).

questions.question: They consider her to be the best candidate. -> She ____ to be the best candidate.
People know that the company is struggling. -> The company is known ____ struggling.
They think that the fire started in the warehouse. -> The fire is thought ____ in the warehouse.
questions.explanation: Acción pasada (el fuego empezó) -> TO HAVE STARTED.

questions.question: Experts estimate that the project will take two years. -> It ____ that the project will take two years.
Police reported that the suspect fled the country. -> The suspect was reported ____ the country.
questions.explanation: El reporte fue en pasado (was reported) y la huida también fue un evento pasado respecto al reporte: TO HAVE FLED.

questions.question: People say the merger is going to happen soon. -> The merger is said ____ soon.
questions.explanation: Se puede simplificar el futuro a TO HAPPEN.

questions.question: They understand that the CEO resigned yesterday. -> The CEO is understood ____ yesterday.
People claim that he has secret bank accounts. -> He is claimed ____ secret bank accounts.
questions.explanation: Acción presente (tener cuentas) -> TO HAVE (infinitivo base).

questions.question: They believed that the document was forged. -> It ____ that the document was forged.
questions.explanation: Creencia en el pasado: It WAS believed.

questions.question: They believed that the document was forged. -> The document was believed ____ forged.
questions.explanation: El documento 'fue' falsificado en el pasado -> TO HAVE BEEN (past infinitive of be).

questions.question: We expect the inflation rate to reach 5%. -> The inflation rate ____ to reach 5%.
People allege that the company evaded taxes. -> The company is alleged ____ taxes.
questions.explanation: Evadió en el pasado -> TO HAVE EVADED.

questions.question: They presume he is innocent. -> He ____ to be innocent.
It ____ that the new rules will improve efficiency. (Se espera).
They found that the software had a bug. -> The software was found ____ a bug.
questions.explanation: Se descubrió (pasado) que el software tenía (estado simultáneo en el pasado) -> TO HAVE.

questions.question: ____ is said that he is rich. (Se dice)
He is said ____ be rich. (Se dice que él es)
It ____ reported that they won. (Se reportó en el pasado)
The CEO is believed to ____ resigned. (haber)
She is expected ____ arrive tomorrow. (llegar)
He is known to ____ stolen the money. (haber)
It is ____ that prices will drop. (se espera - hope)
The company ____ alleged to have evaded taxes. (es)
It is ____ that they are bankrupt. (se cree)
They are thought to have ____ fired. (sido - pasado participio de be)

pairs.source: He is reported to have resigned
pairs.target: Se reporta que él renunció (acción pasada)
Se espera que los precios suban

pairs.source: They are believed to have stolen
She is known to be strict
pairs.target: Se sabe que ella es estricta
